entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Archmage eternal of the School of the Unseen, nemesis of Mairsil, who is stabbed by Lim-Dul but heals himself.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Jodah's old friend who is secretly possessed by Lim-Dul and ascends as a planeswalker when Jodah smashes the mirror into her face.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Necromancer whose consciousness persists in a ruby ring and possesses a new host.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Jodah's nemesis whose mind is in the ruby ring combined with Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who enchanted Jodah's mirror after the World Spell and offers to make him a planeswalker.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Cut off Lim-Dul's hand in the last battle.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: Left in charge of the School of the Unseen; later leads survivors east to found a new institute.

entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: Lim-Dul's keeper at Tresserhorn who created the Lord of Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Balduvian leader who fought alongside Jodah and Jaya.

entities.name: Lothar Lovisason
entities.description: Lovisa's son, leader of the Balduvians who meet Jodah.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: King of Kjeldor who sends an army to aid the Balduvians.

entities.name: Princess Alexandrite
entities.description: Princess who accompanies Jodah and flies for help.

entities.name: Varchild
entities.description: Jodah's old ally who leads the Kjeldoran army besieging Lovisa's settlement.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: Leader of Soldev.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker in need of a cure for his insanity, whom Jodah visits 300 years later.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: Jodah's school, reduced to rubble in the end.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: City destroyed by Phyrexian War Beasts under Lim-Dul's control.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Lim-Dul's old keep under siege by zombified Knights of Stromgald.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Isle to which the War Beasts teleport and where the artifact beasts are destroyed.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: Barbarians raided by the Kjeldorans.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: People of Kjeldor, whose lands fall to the sea.

entities.name: Soldevi Adnates
entities.description: Soldevi group with access to the vaults of the Machinists who help Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Phyrexian War Beasts
entities.description: Eight Phyrexian war beasts activated by Jodah's blood and used to destroy Soldev.

events.summary: At the last battle against Lim-Dul, Leshrac cuts off the necromancer's hand and the ruby ring holding Mairsil/Dul's mind seeks a new host.
events.quote: just after Leshrac has cut off the necromancer's hand

events.summary: Twenty years later Jaya shows Jodah the blackened hand of Dul, claiming to have found it in a Soldev market.
events.quote: She shows him the blackened hand of Dûl which she claims to have found in a market in Soldev .

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya find at Tresserhorn only Chaeska and her undead Lord of Tresserhorn, and Jodah notes the Bottomless Pit has disappeared.
events.quote: Jodah realizes this is a dead-end but does discover that the Bottomless Pit under Tresserhorn has disappeared.

events.summary: Students at the School find a cloud of black mana in the basement; Gerda recalls Lim-Dul asking her to look after his bottomless pit.
events.quote: twenty years ago Lim-Dûl contacted her, offering to take Jodah off her hands

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya meet Lovisa's Balduvians, who say the Kjeldorans are raiding them, and Jaya takes Lim-Dul's finger from a shaman.
events.quote: Jaya sees one of the Balduvian shamans carrying Lim-Dûl's finger as a talisman

events.summary: In Kjeld Jodah is attacked by a Phantasmal Fiend sent by Lim-Dul; Jaya falls ill.
events.quote: Then Jaya suddenly falls very ill.

events.summary: Jodah holds off a Kjeldoran siege of the Balduvians until Darien's army arrives, discovers the attacker is Varchild, and negotiates peace laying the groundwork for New Argive.
events.quote: Jodah lays the groundwork for New Argive

events.summary: A Soldevi Sentry attacks Jodah and Jaya, and Jodah finds his mirror now magnifies spells.
events.quote: Jodah discovers that his mirror now not only reflects spells but also magnifies their force

events.summary: Beneath Soldev, Lim-Dul reveals himself as Jaya, stabs Jodah in the throat, and uses his blood to activate the War Beasts, which destroy Soldev.
events.quote: There Lim-Dûl reveals himself: all this time he had been Jaya!

events.summary: Freyalise offers to make Jodah a planeswalker, but he realizes he has no spark and heals himself.
events.quote: He quickly gathers the mana for a healing spell and jumps back to his body, healing himself at the last possible moment.

events.summary: Jodah chooses to save his friend over his school; he smashes the mirror into Jaya's face and she ascends as a planeswalker, purging Dul and Mairsil.
events.quote: she indeed ascends, purging Dûl and Mairsil from her mind

events.summary: The School of the Unseen is mostly reduced to rubble; Gerda leads survivors east, Jaya leaves, and Jodah disappears from history.
events.quote: Jodah himself decides to disappear from the history books.

events.summary: In the epilogue, 300 years later, Jodah goes to Urza's cottage in the Ohran Mountains to tell him what happened.
events.quote: This person is Urza , a planeswalker desperately in need of someone who can cure his insanity.

relations.quote: Jodah is then visited by his old friend Jaya Ballard.

relations.note: Jodah is the nemesis of Mairsil.

relations.quote: He stabs Jodah through the throat
He takes them to his mother, Lovisa Coldeyes
Arcum Dagsson , the leader of Soldev

relations.note: Left in charge of the School while he is gone.
relations.quote: Jodah has left Gerda Äagesdotter in charge of the School while he is gone.
